scope: Validation-only implementation-currency diagnosis. No fit, A-E candidate score, support, family, collateral, selection, final row, threshold change, or recovery credit is licensed.
primary_diagnosis_rule: A scorer-currency repair is licensed only if OON replay and canonical_q64cast_eval32 both have same-device float32 max absolute row-CE drift <=2e-6. In that case a retry may change only scoring device/dtype/reduction consistency; it may not change serialized program tensors, price, tolerance, rows, candidates, or selection.
noncanonical_variants: Raw, float64, and staged variants are diagnostic only and can never be selected by this protocol. Float64 violates registered float32 serialization. Staged D-then-B evaluation uses a differently priced full original down projection and would require a new preregistration.
stop_rule: If the canonical same-device scorer remains above 2e-6, preserve the diagnostic and stop this projected K4608 retry path. No tolerance relaxation or post-outcome representation choice is licensed.
output_rule: Write only implementation IDs, physical/logit/row-CE drifts, KL diagnostic, poison counters, hashes, and pass/fail. Raw logits, tokens, labels, candidate metrics, and activations are forbidden.
